implementation_notes: Profile before touching anything: `cProfile`/`py-spy` for where time goes, `line_profiler` for one function, `tracemalloc` for allocation. The real wins are usually algorithmic or I/O-bound, not micro-optimisation of interpreted code.
code_sketch:
import cProfile, pstats
pr = cProfile.Profile(); pr.enable()
run_batch()
pr.disable()
pstats.Stats(pr).sort_stats('cumulative').print_stats(15)
pitfalls: Optimising Python bytecode-level tricks that matter only for microseconds
Leaving the real cost — a per-row database call — untouched
Profiling a script but not the production workload shape
